page.layout: One column of verse, with a headpiece and title above it; the signature "F. ij." at the foot right. Page number 83 at the head right. No running head.

main_text.l: VIS me niuosos &[?] Alpium trâs vertices
Non ut parentum laude Romam, vel sua
Te mirer Italum, te Pelasgum gloriam,
Ceu Sol Dianam, ceu Diana cæteras
Nec pectus hac mi perculit cupidine

page.notes: The large initial V of "VIS" is a woodcut ornament, joined to the word. "Coffæe" reads as Cossæe (long s printed like f), marked [?]. The symbol before "Alpium" is unclear and marked [?]. The "F. ij." mark is a gathering signature. The verse is one continuous block with no stanza breaks, so it is one paragraph with the printed line breaks removed.
